### AI image generation

- [PixelForge](https://pixelforge.example/) — Free tier image generator with daily credits. **Free tier · daily credits.**
- [TrialPaint](https://trialpaint.example/) — Free trial only for seven days. **Free trial.**
- [OpenCanvas](https://opencanvas.example/) — Open source image editor you can self-host. **Open source.**
- [PixelForge Mirror](https://pixelforge.example/?utm_source=fixture) — Duplicate entry with tracking parameters.
- [Canvasly](https://canv.as/) — Image design tool with a free plan for small projects.

- [PaidCut](https://paidcut.example/) — Subscription required video editor for teams.
